in_sanskrit.name: Bassu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bassu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the Lord of Wealth and Abundance, derived from the name of Lord Ganesha who is often depicted with a goad (Ankush) and a pot of wealth (Mohini) in his hands.

in_hindi.name: Bassu
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bassu एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the Lord of Wealth and Abundance, derived from the name of Lord Ganesha who is often depicted with a goad (Ankush) and a pot of wealth (Mohini) in his hands.

in_tamil.name: Bassu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of Wealth
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bassu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who is the Lord of Wealth and Abundance, derived from the name of Lord Ganesha who is often depicted with a goad (Ankush) and a pot of wealth (Mohini) in his hands.

in_telugu.name: Bassu
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of Wealth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Bassu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is the Lord of Wealth and Abundance, derived from the name of Lord Ganesha who is often depicted with a goad (Ankush) and a pot of wealth (Mohini) in his hands.

in_marathi.name: Bassu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bassu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the Lord of Wealth and Abundance, derived from the name of Lord Ganesha who is often depicted with a goad (Ankush) and a pot of wealth (Mohini) in his hands.

in_bengali.name: Bassu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bassu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is the Lord of Wealth and Abundance, derived from the name of Lord Ganesha who is often depicted with a goad (Ankush) and a pot of wealth (Mohini) in his hands.
